suggestions.title: What makes sour stuff "clean"?
suggestions.question: What does "clean" leave out here: added sugar, something else, or nothing in particular? I'd put your answer in as a few words in the sentence.
suggestions.why: The newcomer reader asked "What makes sour stuff 'clean', and what kind of sour stuff isn't clean?" Gemini's original says "clean, sour profiles" and no more, so I didn't guess.

suggestions.title: Along with glutamine, or instead of it?
suggestions.question: Should a reader have these sour foods along with glutamine, or are they an option for someone who doesn't take glutamine? Or leave it unsaid?
suggestions.why: The newcomer reader asked "Why would my gut cells need another fuel if glutamine already does the job? ... should I have these along with glutamine or instead of it?" The original says "alternative fuel" and no more.
